messages:
anya: Free pickup — Dell 27" QHD (U2719D) monitor, works great, tiny scuff on the bottom bezel. Also a large ceramic greenhouse-style planter (can fit a big fiddle/monster). Curbside SOMA, building A lobby. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/xyz — can hold until Friday morning.

jamal: omg i'll take the planter if caitlin doesn't. can i swing by after 6pm?

owen: interested in the monitor — does it come with DP cable and stand?

anya: monitor includes stand + DisplayPort cable but no official Dell power brick (uses standard IEC C13). i can include a spare power cable unless someone specifically needs the brick. pics in album: https://imgur.com/a/xyz

carly: @anya I'll take the monitor if jamal wants the planter — can you hold till Friday 5pm? :pray:

jamal: planter is mine then. friday 6pm is fine, i'll DM pickup address. also i have some small succulent pots in the free pile if anyone wants them.

owen: sounds great — DM'ing now. quick q: is the monitor 2560x1440? trying to match my setup.

anya: yep 2560x1440. i'll leave the monitor in the lobby labeled 'Redwood pickup' with my name. pls bring a dolly or helper if you can, it's heavier than it looks. :seedling::truck:

deliv-bot: Reminder: curbside pickup allowed between 5-7pm on Fridays in SOMA building A lobby. See building entry rules: https://redwood.internal/policies/curbside

carly: :raised_hands: sweet, thanks anya!
